The '''Vivab [[Desert/Legends|deserts]]''' were [[Water/Legends|ice]]-swept plains located on [[the Clar]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which, according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'', corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]].</ref> they had been explored and charted by [[Barosa Warren]] and [[Casti Tholon]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Vivab deserts were first mentioned in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] supplement written by [[Craig Robert Carey]], [[J. P. Pietrzak]], [[Bill Smith]], and [[Trevor J. Wilson]] for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> and released in [[June]] [[1995]].<ref name="AIR release date">[[Star Wars Adventure Journal 6|''Star Wars Adventure Journal'' 6]]</ref>
